titles.romaji: Young Harlock wo Oe! Cosmo Warrior Zero Gaiden
titles.native: ヤングハーロックを追え! コスモウォーリアー零外伝

description:
Pirates have kidnapped Zero in an attempt to finally defeat the notorious Captain Harlock. Harlock is bound by a promise to his friend Toshiro to protect his lab on a strange mushroom planet. Fates collide as Zero, Harlock, Sylviana and the pirate Hunter all pursue their own agendas during one decisive battle.

(Source: Anime News Network)
